hilton.songTitle: The Ballad of John and Yoko
hilton.line: Drove from Paris to the Amsterdam Hilton
hilton.lineNext: Talking in our beds for a week
stanza: Drove from Paris to the Amsterdam Hilton
Talking in our beds for a week
The news people said, “Say what you doing in bed?”
I said, “We're only trying to get us some peace”

hilton.linePrev: And even Lord Byron was leaving for Greece
hilton.line: While back at the Hilton, last but not least
stanza: Shelley and Keats were out in the street
And even Lord Byron was leaving for Greece
While back at the Hilton, last but not least
Milton was holding his sides
Saying, "You bravos had better be ready to fight
Or we'll never get out of East Texas tonight
That the trail is long and the river is wide
And my ride's here"

hilton.linePrev: And there's a painting on the wall beside the bed
hilton.line: The watercolor sky at Hilton Head
hilton.lineNext: Then I see you in that summer when we met
stanza: There's a lady shining shoes up by the door
And cowboy boots for seven dollars more
And I remember how you loved to see them shine
So I run upstairs and get a pair of mine
And there's a painting on the wall beside the bed
The watercolor sky at Hilton Head
Then I see you in that summer when we met
And that boy you left in tears in his Corvette

hilton.linePrev: I stand straight like an angel with a halo
hilton.line: Hangin' out the Hilton Hotel window
stanza: My body is a map of LA
I stand straight like an angel with a halo
Hangin' out the Hilton Hotel window
Screamin', "Hey, you, baby, let's go"
My chest, the Sierra Madre
My hips, every high and byway
That you trace with your fingertips like a Toyota
Run your hands over me like a Land Rover

hilton.line: I can't sleep at home tonight, send me a Hilton Hotel
hilton.lineNext: Or a cross on the hill, I'm a lost little girl
stanza: In Arcadia, Arcadia
All roads that lead to you as integral to me as arteries
That pump the blood that flows straight to the heart of me
America, America
I can't sleep at home tonight, send me a Hilton Hotel
Or a cross on the hill, I'm a lost little girl
Findin' my way to you, Arcadia
